{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

print("\nColumn dtypes:")
print(df.dtypes)

print("\nUnique values in channel:")
print(df['channel'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in status:")
print(df['status'].unique())

print("\nDistribution of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].value_counts().head(10))

print("\nCount of -1 in customer_age:")
print((df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

print("\nNumber of rows with revenue == '999999.99':")
print((df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
